seeds.original_dataset_seed_status: Unknown; reproducibility relies on unchanged CSV hashes.
seeds.deterministic_models: No random seed applicable to rules/ETS/ARIMA/legacy deterministic classifiers.

table_numbering: Revision export aliases: IV forecasts, V volatility, VI router simulation, VII ablations, VIII health, IX engine, X LLM. Supplied original PDF instead has only I-VII and its VI contains four fixtures; no updated manuscript was supplied.

IV.configuration: eval_script.py: gig_income_data.csv first165 train/last15 test. Its so-called historical-mean baseline averages only last15 training days, hence MA15; not full-history mean.

V.textual_claim: Paper says four synthetic health scenarios but table and executable contain three.

VI.nonreproduction_reason: Original ideal fixture lacks valid forecast/volatility analytics required by revised fail-closed router.

VII.qualification: Paper gives inequality claims with no archived raw timings. Mean/median and maxima must be distinguished; exact original timing cannot be reproduced.

IV_forecasting.qualification: Overlapping rolling targets and five platform clusters; model selection uses validation only. Production replacement guard fails.

V_volatility.target: next14 realized sampleCV; training-only global terciles
V_volatility.qualification: Reconstruction of a synthetic statistic is not independent financial-risk validation; only five platform clusters.
V_volatility.historical_comparator_role: The frozen audit runtime_cv30 name denotes archived .35/.75; deployed result is separately .45/.75.

VII_ablations.matched_participation_definition: Exact monthly clearance counts, not ever-cleared union or positive investment participation.
VII_ablations.random_gate_denominator: Five assignments on the same50000 households:250000 dependent assignment-household trials, not250000 independent users.
VII_ablations.suitability_proxy: Own illustrative surplus/risk/liquidity checklist; not a regulatory or commercial-advisor implementation.
limitations: Five source-platform clusters only; CIs conditional on synthetic simulator assumptions.
No product lock-ins/minima/ranking, actual market backtest or real-world financial-safety validation.
All generated risk preferences are low; surplus and liquidity proxy are illustrative.

selected.criterion: validation Brier, then AUC, then smaller C

adoption.diagnostic_learned_models: Not eligible under the existing adoption guard; risk probabilities lack validated health-phase mapping.

X_llm.qualification: Fresh125 API requests; model ID is not immutable weights. Rate limits retained; constrained templates, not free-text quality validation.

router_fixtures.positive_definition: Allow under documented conservative engineering policy; not actual financial safety.

real_provenance.earnings: published trip earnings including listed tips/surge, before operating costs
real_provenance.timezone: source naive recorded dates; not independently verified

validation_only_selection.criterion: predeclared protocol risk budgets then participation, wealth, higher L, lower D

failures: score income-sensitive with all other factors fixed
fallback detects falling and rising forecasts

tests.qualification: Unique suite totals only; repeated runs by report scripts and prompt3 excluded. Known retained failures are not suppressed.

performance.qualification: Local timings and loopback HTTP timings are distinct from the separately measured live LLM network latency; concurrent benchmark load may affect timings.

limitations: Simulation outcomes do not establish actual financial safety or market profitability.
Original income/label provenance unverified despite recovered statistical-label notebook.
Health scalar defect retained after failed predeclared adoption guard; no score contribution measured in ablations.
Matched monthly clearance is not matched actual investing or ever-cleared share.
Full gate loses to savings ranking on central forced sales; retain every scenario and uncertainty interval.
Original paper was not changed; stale text must be revised manually.

table_VI_wealth_vs_text.reason: No updated manuscript supplied; preserved RESULTS_FOR_PAPER.md quotes the older whole-system wealth difference. Generated snippets use the corrected current value.

volatility_gain_inside_paired_ci.recomputation: Paired5000-draw whole-platform bootstrap was recomputed from saved target/prediction rows in revision_audit/evaluate.py; not adjusted to force inclusion.

count_derived_percentages.configuration_note: Nominal coverage, CI confidence and weight/intervention settings are configuration values. sMAPE averages relative errors, not a binary event count.

baseline_comparisons.relative_change_note: Relative change is arithmetic, not a count-derived empirical percentage; zero references are undefined.
